claim: There exists a consistent unitary dynamical quantum theory with local chiral observables whose exact automorphism symmetry is the Monster and whose measurable thermal and defect amplitudes are the Moonshine functions.
physicalityCriteria: state space with positive inner product
local operator product and stress tensor
observable spectra, thermal traces and transport
faithful symmetry action preserving the operator algebra

premises.statement: The even unimodular positive Leech Gram matrix defines an invertible 2+1-dimensional Abelian topological phase with a 24-boson unitary chiral edge.
The consistent inversion orbifold extension V_Lambda^+ plus (V_Lambda^T)^+ is the Moonshine VOA V-natural.
V-natural is unitary, holomorphic, has central charge 24 and weight-one space zero, and its full automorphism group is the Monster.
Its stress tensor gives H=(2 pi hbar v/L)(L0-c/24), and its characters, line insertions, OPE coefficients and thermal Hall response are physical observables.

deduction: P1 supplies a conventional physical bulk/edge carrier.
P2 identifies a consistent orbifold/extension of that carrier with V-natural rather than an output-matching emulator.
P3 identifies the exact symmetry acting on its states and operator products as the Monster.
P4 supplies dynamics and operational observables.
Therefore the Monster has an exact physical realization as a symmetry of a consistent dynamical quantum theory.

independentPhysicalRealization.statement: Heterotic Monster compactifications independently realize Moonshine series as spacetime BPS indices, modular groups as T-dualities and Monster Lie algebras as broken gauge-symmetry algebras.
independentPhysicalRealization.scope: zero string coupling and effectively 0+1-dimensional compactification

associatedStructures.JordanSpin23: a selected H2(R) Griess operator corner and its TKK sp(4,R)=so(2,3) response algebra are exact inside the physical CFT
associatedStructures.exceptionalE8: Norton-Sakuma/affine-E8 labels form an exact Ising-pair operator atlas, not an affine E8 current algebra because V1=0
associatedStructures.defects: 2A, 23AB and order-46 elements define invertible symmetry lines and inserted traces; associated self-orbifold duality defects can be non-invertible, and their junction and power-map relations are genuine operator structures of the Monster CFT

the Monster is a symmetry of four-dimensional spacetime
nature uniquely or fundamentally selects the Monster

verdict: Monster is physics is proved as an existence statement in theoretical physics; laboratory realization and selection by nature remain falsifiable open promotions.
